claims.claim: Can be used for storage of any kind of Liquid
claims.evidence: Witness only reports blue metal drums with lids and side bungs/ports; no readable markings or prior contents/cleaning status shown to confirm suitability for any liquid.

risks.risk: Unknown drum capacity/size (e.g., 50L/100L/200L) affects value and how many liters you can store per drum.
risks.proof: A clear shot of the drum’s stamped/printed capacity marking (or a tape-measure/scale shot showing height and diameter).
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used metal drums with unknown capacity (worst-case: lower capacity and/or not standardized).

risks.risk: Condition of seams/welds and whether there is rust-through, dents, or pinholes that could leak.
risks.proof: Close-up clips of the full circumference of weld/seam lines plus a bottom view and any dented areas (including inside if possible).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially leaky/needs inspection (worst-case: treat as for non-critical storage only).

risks.risk: Lid/bung integrity: gaskets, caps/bungs included, and whether ports seal properly.
risks.proof: A close-up of each bung/port showing the cap/bung and gasket condition, plus a shot of the lid sealing surface.
risks.if_unproven: Price as missing/uncertain sealing parts (worst-case: assume you must replace bungs/gaskets).

risks.risk: Prior contents and cleaning status (chemical/oil residue) which can limit what liquids they’re safe for and may require reconditioning.
risks.proof: Photos of any residue/odor indicators (inside walls) and any documentation/label remnants; also a close-up of any markings that indicate prior use.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used drums with unknown residue (worst-case: assume cleaning/reconditioning needed).

risks.risk: Brand/model/specification unknown; some drums are not food-grade or not suitable for certain chemicals.
risks.proof: Clear readable markings/stamps (brand, UN rating, material grade, food-grade/chemical spec if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-specified industrial drums (worst-case: restrict to general storage only).

risks.risk: Quantity and whether all drums match the same specification; mixed sizes/conditions reduce lot value.
risks.proof: A wide shot showing the full count and a side-by-side comparison of a few drums’ markings/condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mixed/uncertain lot (worst-case: assume variability).

proof_requests: Show a clear close-up of any stamped/printed capacity and drum specification markings (height/diameter if markings are absent).
Provide bottom and seam/weld close-ups (including any dents/rust spots).
Show bung/port close-ups with caps/bungs and gaskets (confirm whether caps are included).
Show inside of at least 1–2 drums (residue/rust condition) and any evidence of cleaning.
Confirm quantity and whether all drums are the same size/specification (wide shot + a few matching close-ups).
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as blue metal drums with lids and side bungs/ports, so a worst-case price can be set for used, unspecified industrial drums; key details (capacity, sealing condition, residue, and specs) are not shown, so risks are priced in until proven.
